metadata.name: Schoolbag
metadata.description: Companion mod for the Schoolbag app: a bottom-screen HUD for The Binding of Isaac on dual-screen handhelds like the AYN Thor. This mod doesn't change the game. It shares your run (health, items, map, room, stats) with the Schoolbag app on the same device over a local-only connection. Needs the --luadebug launch option.
